generationInputs.prompt: A modern CD jewel case, centered against a dark gray to black abstract background, showcases the cover art for a fictional opera album. The album insert features vibrant, contemporary vector artwork with a clean aesthetic and bold outlines, reflecting a dramatic and artistic mood with bright, contrasting colors and whimsical motifs. The central image is a stylized, polished, clear diamond with brilliant facets, around which abstract white smoke or vapor swirls on the left, partially obscuring it. To the right of the diamond, an abstract peach, an abstract eggplant, and an abstract clear plastic syringe with a light blue tip are positioned vertically. The syringe, rendered in simplified graphic form, contains a clear liquid with black measurement markings, and its thin metallic needle points upwards. The bold album title "you & me, and you, and you" is in a wide, rounded typeface, with "mega rush" as a subtitle. A fictional label name and logo, "bareback inter ff dld & lencería" are in one corner. The composition is polished and editorial, like a conceptual product photo with a minimalist feel. The background is completely black, and a lightning bolt is added to the cover, creating a 3D effect.
